tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bzhi thog gi mgon khang chen mo gsar du bzhengs pa'i dkar chag bla ma'i lung bstan mngon du gyur pa'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi phreng ba bzhugs// na mo gu ru shrī mahā kā la ye/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir gdan sa thams cad kyi/ /mchog tu gyur pa dpal ldan sa skya yi/ /bzhi thog bla brang chen po'i nub phyogs 'dir/ /gur gyi mgon po la sogs sa skya pa'i/ /bka' srung rnams kyis rjes bzung rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /sngon nas med pa gsar du bskrun pa yi/ /mgon khang chen mo srid gsum rnam rgyal zhes/ /mtshan du gsol 'di sngon tshe bka' drin can/ /yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas grags pa'i mtshan/ /de nyid gsung las nged kyi bsam pa la/ /ji ltar yod pa'i rig 'dzin lha khang dang / /de yi 'og gi mgon khang gsar bzhengs sogs/ /nged kyi re ba'i lhag ma 'di dag kun/ /khyod kyis lag len byed dgos 'gyur ro zhes/ /sngags 'chang de nyid gzhan ngor sku bsnyel ba'i/ /rnam pa tsam yang ston par ma mdzad pa'i/ /sngon rol nyid nas yang yang bka' stsal ba/ /deng dus mngon du gyur tshe yab rje der/ /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i ye shes spyan/ /nges par mnga' ba'i dad pa cher skyes nas/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyi bris thang dang / /chos skyong gur zhal dur khrod bdag po dang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i las mkhan dkar bdud dang / /phur srung bcu gnyis dpal ldan dmag zor ma/ /phyag bzhi phyag drug beng dang trag gshed dang / /stag bzhon zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul sogs/ /mdor na chos skyong srung ma'i rigs mang po'i/ /bris thang bla ma gong ma'i phyag nas dang / /thugs dam rten gyur ye shes mngon sum du/ /bzhugs par nges pa'i bris thang bgrang yas rnams/ /mgon khang chen po'i logs dang ka ba yi/ /ngos rnams dag la brtan par bzhugs gsol zhing / /rten gyi gtso bo yab rje de nyid kyi/

/phyag bris 'khrul med gur zhal rnam pa gnyis/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i bris thang drug phrag gcig /khyad par bstan srung so so dngos byon 'dra'i/ /'bur sku gsar bzhengs gur mgon lha bcu gnyis/ /ru 'dren sde bzhir bcas dang zhing skyong gtso/ /bram ze'i gzugs dang dkar bdud lcam dral dang / /nor skyong dur khrod bdag po yab yum gnyis/ /dmag zor rgyal mor bcas pa'i sku rnams te/ /rten mchog rnams kyi steng du zhing chen gyi/ /bla bre che dang ka ba bar snang sogs/ /kun tu khyab pa'i chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi/ /phyag mtshan yongs rdzogs gcan gzan lpags pa'i tshogs/ /khrab rmog gri sogs dpa' bo'i chas mang po/ /gos dar lda ldi 'phyang 'phrul thug chen sogs/ /spyan gzigs ma tshang med pas kun khyab cing / /gzhan yang dam rdzas gtor tshogs ri ltar spungs/ /dam nyams bsgral ba'i thod pa mchod rdzas kyis/ /phyur bur bkang ba mang po tshar du dngar/ /rnga chen dung chen la sogs dam can rnams/ /mnyes par byed pa'i yo byad kyis gang ba'i/ /gnas chen der bslebs tsam gyis skye bo kun/ /'jigs shing skyi bung byed pa'i mgon khang 'di/ /yab rje de nyid dgongs pa rdzogs phyir bsgrubs/ /bsod nams 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag slob mar bcas dang 'gro ba kun/ /tshe ring nad med bsam pa mthar phyin cing / /'chi tshe bar do'i 'jigs skrag mi myong bar/ /chos skyong rnams la 'phrin las bcol ba ltar/ /mkha' spyod bde ldan mngon dga' la sogs pa/ /dag pa'i zhing du thogs med legs khrid nas/ /zhing de'i rgyal ba'i zab mo'i chos nos te/ /rang rgyud grol nas gang 'dul sprul pa yis/ /bstan pa spyi dang bye brag sa skya pa/ /khyad par sngags 'chang yab sras bstan 'di nyid/ /srid mthar 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i mthu ldan shog /maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o//
